name: telegram-agent-estate
description: Run a personal Claude agent as a Telegram-driven daemon: an owned long-poll receiver journals every inbound message to a durable receipt WAL, and a flock-serialized runner answers it with one `claude -p --resume` per turn. Crash-safe, exactly-once, subscription-billed. One plugin, many instances.
tryAsking: Set up a new Telegram agent instance for this repo
Why did my bot not answer the last message?
Run the parity suite against this instance
Add an MCP tool to this instance's permission allowlist
